heading_script_line: Where Every Part Has a Purpose.
body_text: Learning here is connected and joyful. A story can lead to a question, a question to an investigation, and an investigation to mathematics.

items.title: Outdoor Free Play
items.text_2: The day begins with possibility. Children choose what to play, who with and how.

items.title: Circle Time
items.text_2: Connecting before learning: we talk, sing, share stories and wonder.

items.title: Provocation Tables
items.text_2: Carefully chosen materials invite children to stop, wonder and investigate.

items.title: Language & Literacy
items.text_2: Stories, songs, rhymes and books build speaking, listening, reading and writing.

items.title: Mathematical Thinking
items.text_2: Mathematics you can touch: blocks, patterns, measuring, sorting and shapes.

items.title: Physical Development
items.text_2: Climbing, balancing, running and jumping build confident movers.

items.title: Creative Expression
items.text_2: Art, theatre, music and dance: many ways to say “This is my idea.”

items.title: Mealtime Together
items.text_2: Children eat together, serve themselves and practise table manners.
